_comment: Per-game Discord application credentials. Each game is its own Discord app (one app per game), so its creds live here, keyed by game id. Copy to abiotic-factor.discord.json (gitignored) and fill in from the Discord Developer Portal. Falls back to .env (DISCORD_APP_ID / DISCORD_BOT_PUBLIC_KEY / DISCORD_BOT_SECRET_TOKEN) when this file is absent.
